summary: A dispatch-pinned review report names one CD-0242 D5 disposition and up to 64 ranked findings with closed severity and confidence. Oracle-bound findings classify delivery blockers, uncovered cases, follow-ups, and oracle defects, with source bindings and canonical ordinal lineage. Closed resolution claims name finding IDs and qualifying evidence. Main records acceptance of the disposition, and an open in-scope blocking finding blocks a new assignment and leaving execution. The report grants no workflow verdict or acceptance authority.
title: A review report carries a typed verdict and ranked findings
